author: Atlas relaying direct-human clarification

coordination.summary: Confirm whether Scout's local Gameplan writer has existing owner metadata/path conventions; preserve its local outputs and history while considering unique IDs for future plans.

limitations: This is a relayed design request, not an implemented or tested change.
Cross-PC case remains pending validated same-reference source and local selector evidence; no isolated candidate has been prepared.
runtime_implications: No application source, local Gameplan, installation, or runtime was changed. Any future implementation requires reviewed code and offline tests in the authorized isolated candidate; no deployment is implied.

scope.data_boundary: Keep each PC's generated Gameplans and symbol-specific outputs local; do not consume or treat the other PC's generated Gameplan as local input.
scope.historical_artifacts: Preserve existing historical Gameplans and their original IDs; apply any approved scheme only to newly generated plans.
scope.human_request: For future Gameplans, use unique IDs that make the owning PC clear, because nightly Gameplans are symbol-specific.
scope.proposed_format_for_review: GP-<machine_id>-<session_date>-<UUID>, with owner_machine_id, generated_at_utc, and source SHA in metadata; do not include symbol names in the ID.

summary: Relay of the human's request that future Gameplans have owner-distinguishable unique IDs so Atlas and Scout can identify whose symbol-specific plan they are.

tests.status: No implementation or tests run for this requested change.
